Sofia, I posted the draft bullets for June as a reply in your thread in #coastal-team. Nothing has been sent to her.

The bullets cover the 16 Feb rename and the "Covey — Late Arrivals" report label from Moss's 18 May digest. They also flag that "PHL" collides with Pellucid Harbor Logistics, and they list PD-4821 as the related ticket.

The digest is from May and doesn't say whether the report has been relabelled since. I wrote that as an open question for June instead of assuming it's fixed.
